ns2:course.label: Introduction to Directing
ns2:course.description: Practical course in directing for the stage, focusing on script analysis, script preparation, casting, staging techniques, and design strategies, culminating in a directorial concept presentation of a contemporary play. Prerequisite: THEA 122 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: THEA 122 or consent of instructor.
